title: Loan default rate by risk segment
prompt: Risk wants to know: which customer risk segment has the highest loan default rate?
population: All loans, joined to their customer's risk_segment.
metricDefinition: defaulted loans / total loans, grouped by customer risk_segment.
referenceSql: SELECT c.risk_segment, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'default')::DOUBLE / count(*) AS default_rate FROM loans l JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id GROUP BY c.risk_segment

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT c.risk_segment, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'default') FROM loans l JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id GROUP BY c.risk_segment
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Returns the default count, not the rate — segments with more loans overall will look worse even if their true default rate is lower.
